snippet.title: Batman Forever: The Arcade Game (1996) PS1 - Gameplay HD
snippet.description:
Batman Forever: The Arcade Game is a beat 'em up video game based on the movie Batman Forever. The subtitle is used to differentiate it from Batman Forever, another beat 'em up published by Acclaim at around the same time.

Initial release date: 1996
Publisher: Acclaim Entertainment
Mode: Multiplayer video game
Platforms: Playstation, Microsoft Windows, Sega Saturn, DOS, Arcade game, MS-DOS
Genres: Beat 'em up, Fighting game
Developers: Iguana Entertainment, Inc., Acclaim Studios London, Acclaim Entertainment
Designers: Iguana Entertainment, Inc., David Dienstbier
